sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: recording-fingerprints: the "AcoustID" column's 📊 unique-values dropdown now offers an "AcoustID info - Link status" section (🔗 linked / 🚫 unlinked), letting you filter to just the AcoustIDs that are still linked to this recording or just the ones that have been unlinked. The unlinked entry reuses MusicBrainz's own "disabled-acoustid" styling directly.
